verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Capacities exposes itself as an MCP *server* (via a documented MCP endpoint and 'build your own MCP client to integrate with a Capacities space'), and offers Chat Connectors so external AI apps (ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor) can pull data from Capacities. There is no evidence that Capacities itself acts as an MCP *client* that plugs in external MCP servers so it can use their tools — the direction described in the story is reversed in the evidence pack.
